title: Require Civ7 V8 Runtime Import Admission
forbids: a runtime:civ7-v8 production source edge that is not positively admitted for the embedded isolate
why: Civ7 isolate compatibility is a whole-project closure. Production source may use only local production members and exact official declaration dependencies; host, Node, Bun, Tuner, and unresolved imports are excluded by construction.
remediate: Keep generated API imports local, or use only the exact type-only official module and Solid declaration specifiers admitted by the projection. Split host behavior into an untagged project instead of adding an exception.
message: This import is outside the positively admitted Civ7 V8 runtime realm.
